summary: The diff implements both REQ-69 and REQ-70 largely as specified. A new QRCode component is created at frontend/src/components/shared-assets/QRCode.tsx with a re-export barrel at frontend/src/components/shared-assets/qr-code.ts, and QrPage.tsx is updated to use the new component. However, the implementation loads qr-code-styling via a CDN script tag rather than using the qr-code-styling npm library directly, which conflicts with the explicit constraint to use the npm library.

hallucinated_features.description: The QRCode component loads qr-code-styling from a CDN (jsdelivr) via a dynamically injected script tag instead of importing it as an npm package dependency.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly constrains use of the qr-code-styling npm library. The diff shows the component fetches the library from a CDN URL at runtime rather than importing the npm package, which violates the stated constraint.
